description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project and implements a test plan navigator page with functions for initializing GUI settings based on different feature modes, and rendering a Smarty template. It includes external dependencies, creates objects for managing test plan navigation, and defines a function 'initializeGui' that configures URLs and UI elements based on feature arguments.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic empty class used to create GUI configuration object.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with settings based on current feature mode, such as URLs, titles, and button visibility.
